title: Scotch-Weld EPX Plus II Applicator 50 ml – Applicator Gun
description: The EPX is a low-cost portable, mixing and dispensing machine that simultaneously meters and mixes two-part adhesives as the material is applied. Ideally suited for 3M “DP” series 50 ml adhesives. The applicator comes with two plungers, (1:1/2:1 shared plunger and 10:1 plunger).
